result.summary: Page is largely intact with no critical breakage. Found 3 issues: truncated restaurant name at carousel edge, inconsistent time-badge formatting, and bottom card clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the screen edge
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal list end-padding and use ellipsis truncation so names don't appear cut off mid-character

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' without spaces vs '20-30 min' with spaces
issues.suggestion: Standardize to one format with spaces around the dash, e.g. '20 - 30 min' or '20–30 min', across all badges

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card with '-20%' badge is flush against and clipped by the bottom tab bar with no padding, hiding its restaurant name and details
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset above the fixed tab bar so cards are fully visible when scrolled into view
